basic_details.job_title: SCD TN Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline for 21 Expert, District Representative and More Posts
basic_details.short_information: Persons with disabilities can apply until 23 November 2026, 5.00 PM for 21 new member positions on the State Advisory Board for Persons with Disabilities. The positions are 5 Experts, 5 District Representatives (on a rotational basis) and 11 Representatives from NGOs or Associations. The District Collector of Kancheepuram, Thiru. T. Sneha, I.A.S., announced the call in a press release. The prescribed application form is on www.scd.tn.gov.in. Expert applications go to the Commissionerate for Welfare of the Differently Abled in Chennai by post or email. Applications for the other two categories

rows.details: State Advisory Board for Persons with Disabilities (press release by the District Collector, Kancheepuram District)
Expert; District Representative (on a rotational basis); Representative from NGOs or Associations
Prescribed form submitted to the office named for each category (post or email for Experts)

content_sections.heading: About the State Advisory Board for Persons with Disabilities
content_sections.text: Members of the State Advisory Board for Persons with Disabilities are appointed under the Rights of Persons with Disabilities Act and the Tamil Nadu Rights of Persons with Disabilities Rules, 2018. The press release says the Board had been working with its appointed members. The tenure of the existing Board has now ended, so applications are invited to appoint new members.

content_sections.heading: Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: The notice lists 21 member positions in three categories. The 11 NGO and Association representatives include: 5 women representatives 1 representative from the Scheduled Caste community 1 representative from the Scheduled Tribe community

rows.details_as_printed: Members with professional expertise and experience in the rehabilitation of persons with disabilities, to be nominated by the State Government (Kancheepuram District)
Representatives from five districts: Kancheepuram, Krishnagiri, Sivaganga, Dindigul, Coimbatore
Selected from voluntary organisations and associations (Kancheepuram District)

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: The press release invites applications from persons with disabilities who are interested in these positions. Each category has its own condition: The official notification does not specify the minimum educational qualification, the age limit or the pay. Candidates should refer to the official notification and the prescribed application form for the eligibility of each post.

rows.essential_condition: Professional expertise and experience in the rehabilitation of persons with disabilities

Representative from Kancheepuram, Krishnagiri, Sivaganga, Dindigul or Coimbatore district. Kancheepuram District applicants must apply through the District Differently Abled Welfare Officer, with the approval of the District Collector.
Representative of a voluntary organisation or association

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for State Advisory Board Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Download the prescribed application form from the official website, www.scd.tn.gov.in . Fill in the application form completely. Category 1 (Expert): send the form to The Commissionerate for Welfare of the Differently Abled, Lady Willingdon College Campus, Kamarajar Salai, Chennai – 600 005, or email it to [email protected] . Categories 2 and 3 (District Representative and NGO/Association Representative): submit the form to the District Differently Abled Welfare Office, Kancheepuram District. Kancheepuram District applicants for District Representative: submit through the District Differently Abled Welfare Officer, with the approval of the District Collector. Make sure the application is submitted by 23.11.2026, 5.00 PM. The prescribed application form, duly completed

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: The notice says the five Experts are to be nominated by the State Government. It says the 11 NGO and Association representatives will be selected from voluntary organisations and associations. The notice does not mention a written test, an interview or how candidates will be shortlisted.

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: Use the prescribed application form from the official website. The District Collector of Kancheepuram has asked all eligible and interested applicants to submit their applications within the deadline. District Representatives are chosen on a rotational basis from the five districts named in the notice.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in State Advisory Board Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 21 member positions: 5 Experts, 5 District Representatives (on a rotational basis) and 11 Representatives from NGOs or Associations.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: Applications must be submitted by 23 November 2026, 5.00 PM.

faq.question: Q3. Who can apply for the State Advisory Board member positions?
faq.answer: The press release invites applications from persons with disabilities. Experts must have professional expertise and experience in the rehabilitation of persons with disabilities.

faq.question: Q4. Where can I download the application form?
faq.answer: The prescribed application form can be downloaded from the official website, www.scd.tn.gov.in.

faq.question: Q5. Where should Expert (Category 1) applications be sent?
faq.answer: Expert applications go to The Commissionerate for Welfare of the Differently Abled, Lady Willingdon College Campus, Kamarajar Salai, Chennai – 600 005, or by email to [email protected].

faq.question: Q6. Where should District Representative and NGO Representative applications be submitted?
faq.answer: Applications for Categories 2 and 3 must be submitted to the District Differently Abled Welfare Office, Kancheepuram District.

faq.question: Q7. Which districts are covered for District Representatives?
faq.answer: The five districts on a rotational basis are Kancheepuram, Krishnagiri, Sivaganga, Dindigul and Coimbatore. Kancheepuram applicants must apply through the District Differently Abled Welfare Officer, with the approval of the District Collector.

faq.question: Q8. Are any NGO representative positions set aside for women, SC or ST?
faq.answer: Yes. The 11 NGO and Association representatives include 5 women, 1 representative from the Scheduled Caste community and 1 representative from the Scheduled Tribe community.
